decisions.reason: The daily output cadence does not change the existing approval authority, publication eligibility, or rejected-clip handling rules.
The cadence for meeting the monthly clip quota does not change the Lead Clipper pathway, training, compensation, or responsibilities.
The production cadence applies after hiring and does not modify the current qualification method or success condition.
The source message separately updates this candidate's content and scope rules in an existing same-message Event; the quota cadence adds no further change.
The daily clip cadence does not alter the 45–60-second duration requirement, which is already handled by a separate same-message Event.
The daily output cadence does not alter permitted source material, which is already handled by a separate same-message Event.
The monthly production cadence does not specify or change a clip submission channel or submission workflow.
The cadence does not change which clips may be published or the dedicated Instagram publishing destination.
A required number of clips per day does not change the clean editing, effects, or transition standards.
The daily output cadence does not change caption color, font, or effects requirements.
The cadence for producing clips does not modify the standard for selecting strong and impactful moments.
